│   @ Users              ││   ▌    Services      Vacuum      Upgrade      Compress      Tags      Uninstall            │
│   ▦ Dashboard          ││   ▌  Give the disk space of deleted rows back (Postgres VACUUM). Do it after deleting      │
│   ↻ Updates            ││   ▌  a lot, e.g. after compressing Synapse's state.                                        │
│   ◷ Backups            ││                                                                                            │
│   ↺ Restore            ││      Kind of vacuum                                                                        │
│   ↶ Rollback           ││        Complete (FULL, ANALYZE; services stop)                                             │
│   ✎ Fine-tune          ││        Full (services stop)                                                                │
│ ▌ ⚒ Maintenance        ││        Plain (services keep running)                                                       │
│   ⇢ Move server        ││        Plain + ANALYZE (services keep running)                                             │
│   ▤ Servers            ││        ANALYZE only (fastest)                                                              │
